name: tier-router
description: Picks Haiku, Sonnet or Opus for each prompt with a decision model: tev1 locally in Ollama, or Jev in TypeSafe's cloud. No proxy, no Claude tokens spent on routing.

backend.title: Decision backend
backend.description: ollama: local tev1. jev: TypeSafe's cloud Jev (needs an API key).

tev1Model.title: Decision model
tev1Model.description: The Ollama decision model to ask (tev1 or tev1:0.8b).

jevApiKey.title: TypeSafe API key
jevApiKey.description: Only for the jev backend. Sent to the Jev URL as a bearer token.

jevModel.title: Jev model
jevModel.description: The Jev model id to ask.
